EHJ9400CCY · FENCE SEMI-TRAILER

Stake Semi-Trailer

Multiple Side Heights · Custom Stake Sections · Versatile Cargo Transport

Scroll to Explore

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Versatile Stake Bodies · Straight, Gooseneck, Step-Deck and Truck Options · Optional Tarp Frame

The EHJ9400CCY combines side panels with a flatbed for general cargo, grain, feed, light industrial goods and agricultural supplies. Its layout supports top loading, side access and side-panel cargo retention for versatile handling.

Choose from straight-frame, gooseneck, step-deck and 9.6 m truck-body layouts, with side heights from 0.6 to 1.5 m. Material options include checkered steel, galvanized sheet and aluminum, with 6, 8 or 10 panel sections. Optional tarp frames and covers protect cargo from rain and snow. Xiangqi is listed in China's vehicle type-approval catalog, with factory-direct sales and after-sales support across 30+ provincial regions.

FEATURES

Key Features

Five Design Features · Versatile Cargo Handling

01 VERSIONS

Four Body Layouts

Available as straight-frame stake bodies (standard), gooseneck stake bodies (low center of gravity), step-deck stake bodies (oversized cargo), or 9.6 m Stake Truck Body for short- and medium-distance work, covering a range of haulage needs.

02 FENCE

Choose Side Height and Material

Side Height0.6 / 0.8 / 1.2 / 1.5 m, with materials including Checkered Steel / Galvanized Sheet / Aluminum and 6, 8 or 10 panel sections to suit the cargo.

03 TARP

Optional Tarp Frame

Add an optional tarp frame and weather cover to protect cargo from rain, snow and dust during transport and overnight parking.

04 REAR DOOR

Rear Door Options

Available as Double Rear Doors (forklift access), Top-Hinged Rear Door (one-touch opening), or No Rear Door (top loading), to match the loading method.

05 SAFETY

Dual Braking + ABS

Air brakes (4 dual + 2 single chambers), KOMEE ABS and reflective markings support safe transport at night, in line with the GB 7258 national standard.
